brandPositioningSummary: avid hotels is a essentials-focused midscale / select-service IHG brand within IHG Hotels & Resorts. For owners, the affiliation case is efficient prototype economics, operating simplicity, guest essentials delivery, cost discipline, and IHG distribution. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among Holiday Inn Express, EVEN Hotels, Garner hotels.
ownerFitSummary: efficient prototype economics, operating simplicity, guest essentials delivery, cost discipline, and IHG distribution
propertyFitSummary: new-build and selected conversion sites where owners want midscale essentials with lean operations rather than upper-midscale Holiday Inn Express complexity

scenarios.title: Essentials new-build
scenarios.summary: A new-build midscale site where owners prioritize construction efficiency, lean staffing, and consistent guest essentials. avid is worth evaluating when the market supports value-led demand and the owner wants IHG distribution without Holiday Inn Express’s broader product stack. Owners should diligence whether avid hotels is a better fit than Holiday Inn Express for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Cost-disciplined conversion
scenarios.summary: A conversion candidate that cannot support a heavier select-service offer. avid may fit when the asset can deliver sleep quality, breakfast flexibility, and simple public space while meeting IHG systems requirements. Owners should diligence whether avid hotels is a better fit than Holiday Inn Express for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Portfolio midscale filler
scenarios.summary: Owners adding a midscale essentials flag beside other IHG or competitive brands. Diligence should confirm territory, prototype fit, and whether avid’s guest promise is distinct enough from nearby Holiday Inn Express inventory. Owners should diligence whether avid hotels is a better fit than Holiday Inn Express for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.
